395:t_1:86.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Here come the handsome guys!」

395:t_1:87.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Huh... Aren't $$かなめ$$ and the new Empress of the Sea here?」

395:t_1:88.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ is in space. And, um, $$かなめ$$ is...」

395:t_1:89.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ is operating separately from us at present.」

395:t_1:90.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Don't you miss her, $$宗介$$?」

395:t_1:92.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's all right, $$エイミー$$. ...I intend to visit this fleet again with $$千鳥$$.」

395:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
「I promised to show her the sea, too.」

395:t_1:94.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「It seems your relationship has moved forward a little.」

395:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like $$宗介$$ has sorted out his feelings about $$かなめ$$.」

395:t_1:96.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes. The passage of time has probably helped him calm down, too.」

395:t_1:97.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then $n is the one we need to worry about...」

395:t_1:98.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Come to think of it, I don't see $n anywhere...」

395:t_1:99.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I saw him heading toward the warehouse block earlier.」

395:t_1:100.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...For now, let's throw you all a welcome party tonight.」

395:t_1:102.en:
$$メルティ$$
「You're so overbearing! You're not handsome at all!」

395:t_1:103.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hey, don't say that. He's like the sun beating down on this sea... or something.」

395:t_1:105.en:
$$メルティ$$
「But I don't know... I get the feeling I should absolutely stay away from him...」

395:t_1:106.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「How should I put it? You're no good as a provider.」

395:t_1:108.en:
$$レド$$
「But $$ランド$$ and $$クロウ$$ are both dear friends of mine.」

395:t_1:109.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's nice of you to say, $$レド$$.」

395:t_1:110.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If they've taken care of you, $$レド$$, then they're important guests to us, too.」

395:t_1:112.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Welcome home, $$レド$$. This fleet is the place you come home to, right?」

395:t_1:114.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's go see $$ベベル$$, $$レド$$. I'm sure he wants to see you, too.」

395:t_1:115.en:
$$レド$$
「I have plenty I want to tell $$ベベル$$, too.」

395:t_1:116.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Be back in time for the party. I'll have freshly caught seafood ready. Look.」

395:t_1:117.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Wow...! There's so much fish and shellfish!」

395:t_1:118.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look, $$ティファ$$! There's a huge octopus, too!」

395:t_1:121.en:
$$レド$$
「That soft body and those tentacles...」

395:t_1:126.en:
$n
(...Everyone... They're all being considerate of me...)

395:t_1:127.en:
$n
(So I have to pull myself together soon... for everyone, for Miss $$スズネ$$, and for myself.)

395:t_1:128.en:
$n
(When I'm feeling down, I move my body... Now's the time to get back to basics.)

395:t_1:131.en:
$n
(Use no way as the way, and use the infinite as the finite...)

395:t_1:132.en:
???
「Wow...! That dance you just did was amazing...!」

395:t_1:135.en:
$n
「That's the name of the martial art I practice.」

395:t_1:137.en:
$n
「...Are you from the $$ガルガンティア船団$$?」

395:t_1:138.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I came here a little while ago. ...I'm $$ティティ$$. What's your name?」

395:t_1:140.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you from the fleet, too, $f? I haven't seen you before...」

395:t_1:141.en:
$n
「Not quite. I'm... Let's see... I came here to volunteer.」

395:t_1:143.en:
$n
「It means working for others out of a desire to help.」

395:t_1:145.en:
$n
「...I wonder. I enjoy it well enough.」

395:t_1:146.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I'd like you to teach me, too, if you enjoy it, $f.」

395:t_1:149.en:
$n
「That's not it. It was so sudden that I was a little surprised.」

395:t_1:150.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Aren't surprises like that fun?」

395:t_1:152.en:
$$ティティ$$
「People tell me that a lot.」

395:t_1:153.en:
$n
(It's strange... Talking to her makes me feel calmer...)

395:t_4:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So this is where you are, $$ティファ$$.」

395:t_4:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Your dancing earlier... It was really good.」

395:t_4:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Ah... Um... This $$残されの海$$... It's beautiful.」

395:t_4:10.en:
$$ティファ$$
「There are all sorts of life in this sea...」

395:t_4:12.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Sometimes I sense something strange, unlike anything I've ever felt before...」

395:t_4:14.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Am I boring you... talking like this?」

395:t_4:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You aren't boring me at all!」

395:t_4:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Tell me more about all the things you sense, $$ティファ$$.」
